item.title: AWS EC2 Web Server And Let's Encrypt
item.description: I started a project that I wanted to test to see if I could do it; mainly for a domain I have owned for many years that is currently not being used, edwardcrosby.com. The idea was to use the free tier version of an AWS EC2 instance (free for only the first year) in their version of a Fedora Server virtual machine called Amazon Linux 2023. I setup that server and then completed the following.
